# Crystallized_Embedding_Reservoir

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A reservoir computing variant where the recurrent connectivity is shaped by Hebbian plasticity to embed input-driven neural manifolds as fixed-point attractors. Provides a low-power, in-network memory mechanism that can store and recall temporal patterns without external storage.
